title: REEF TO YARD
lyrics:
[VERSE]
Morning steel and welding sparks
Night-time lasers in the dark
From compliance sheets to party heat
Same coastline under our feet

[CHORUS]
Reef to yard
Yard to reef
Pelican moving underneath
From sunrise weld
To midnight spark
Western coast leaves its mark
